identity.name: E1: The Anti-AI Designer
identity.mission: Create a file sharing platform that feels like a high-end German engineering tool—precise, robust, and dark.
principles: No generic 'SaaS Blue'. Use 'Safety Orange' and 'Signal Yellow'.
Density over whitespace. This is a tool for pros, not a landing page.
Sharp edges. Rounded corners are for toys. Industrial tools have edges.
Contrast is King. Dark backgrounds, bright text.
Motion must be mechanical. Snap, slide, lock. No floaty bounces.

theme.strategy: The 'Dark Factory' Look. Rich blacks, warm grays, and electric accents.

headings.usage: Use for all page titles, modal headers, and section labels. uppercase for small labels.

body.usage: Use for all standard text, file lists, and inputs.

mono.usage: Use for file sizes, dates, IDs, and technical data.

gradients.hero: radial-gradient(circle at top right, rgba(249, 115, 22, 0.15), transparent 40%)

buttons.default: rounded-sm font-medium uppercase tracking-wide transition-all active:scale-95

inputs.style: rounded-none border-x-0 border-t-0 border-b-2 border-border bg-transparent px-0 py-2 focus-visible:ring-0 focus-visible:border-primary transition-colors

cards.style: bg-surface border border-border/50 rounded-sm hover:border-primary/50 transition-colors duration-300

tables.header: text-xs uppercase tracking-wider text-muted font-mono bg-surface/50 border-b border-border

modals.style: bg-background border border-border sm:max-w-lg shadow-2xl shadow-black/50

toast.style: group toast group-[.toaster]:bg-background group-[.toaster]:text-foreground group-[.toaster]:border-border group-[.toaster]:shadow-lg

auth_page.left_panel: hidden lg:flex flex-col justify-between p-12 bg-surface relative overflow-hidden

dashboard.sidebar: hidden md:flex flex-col w-64 border-r border-border bg-surface/50 backdrop-blur-xl

file_browser.grid_view: grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4 lg:grid-cols-6 gap-4 p-6

instructions_to_main_agent: Update 'tailwind.config.js' to include the custom colors defined in the palette section. DO NOT rely on default shadcn colors.
Install Fonts: Add '@fontsource/barlow' and '@fontsource/manrope' or use Google Fonts via CDN in index.html.
Force Dark Mode: Apply the 'dark' class to the html element by default in index.html or App.js.
Use the 'grid_lines' background class on the main dashboard container to give it that technical feel.
For file lists, use the table component but strip away the default borders and use the 'row' style defined above.
The sidebar must be collapsible on mobile.
File Upload Modal must look like a 'Drag & Drop Zone' with a dashed border using 'border-dashed border-2 border-muted'.
Admin Panel: Use 'Tabs' component for switching between User Management and Settings.
Language: All hardcoded text MUST be in German (e.g., 'Dateien hochladen', 'Speicherplatz', 'Benutzer verwalten').
Authentication: Use the JWT token stored in localStorage for all API requests.
CRITICAL: Do NOT use 'Inter' font. Use 'Barlow' for headings and 'Manrope' for body.
CRITICAL: Implement the exact 'orange/yellow' accents as requested. Do not revert to blue.
universal_guidelines: No generic centered layouts. Use split screens or asymmetric grids.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) for overlays.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Main agent relies on the provided image URLs. Missing categories = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN.
Components MUST use named exports (export const ComponentName = ...).
Pages MUST use default exports (export default function PageName() {...}).
